name: silvershop/abandoned-cart
description: Abandoned-cart recovery for SilverShop: detect carts left behind, send a timed recovery-email sequence, and restore the cart from a tokenised link — with a self-contained snapshot so recovery survives cart cleanup.

suggest.silvershop/newsletter: Gates recovery mail on the canonical NewsletterConsent opt-in (require_consent mode) and is the seam for the v2 ESP-export delivery.
suggest.silvershop/notification-log: Captures each recovery email as an auditable, GDPR-categorised SentNotification row and provides the data-erasure seam.
suggest.silvershop/store-profile: Shared shop identity used as the sender name/address for the recovery emails.
suggest.silvershop/order-confirmation: Shares the tokenised-order-access idiom; its GuestToken gives placed-order links from the recovery landing.
suggest.silvershop/order-admin: Richer CMS order surfaces alongside the recovery admin.
suggest.silvershop/discounts: v2 incentive coupons injected into the later recovery emails.
